# The Last Sword You Never Forgot - Community Port

**Unofficial.** A community-maintained port of **The Last Sword You Never Forgot** by **CJiangqiu** to NeoForge 1.21.1. It is not made or supported by CJiangqiu: please report problems with this port [on its own issue tracker](https://github.com/jivinstev/TheLastSword/issues), not to the original author.

Published with the original author's permission (https://github.com/CJiangqiu/EpicCoreAPI/issues/9), under the original MIT licence with its copyright notice kept.

## The original

- Though the road ahead is arduous and the blade lies broken, embark on the journey and reforge The Last Sword You Never Forgot.
- Source: https://github.com/CJiangqiu/TheLastSword
- On Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/mod/the-last-sword-you-never-forgot (Forge, 1.20.1)

## What this port changes

- Runs on **NeoForge 1.21.1**.
- Carries fixes for defects found while porting and playing it. Each is tracked, with its evidence and which release fixes it, in an issue:
  - [Pre-existing: dragon-crystal-trimmed dragon crystal armour shows a broken icon](https://github.com/jivinstev/TheLastSword/issues/1)
  - [Pre-existing: summoning The Last Sword's TEST ENTITY switches off every other content mod (global AllReturn) and disconnects the player](https://github.com/jivinstev/EpicCoreAPI/issues/2)

## Requirements

- Required: the community port of https://github.com/jivinstev/EpicCoreAPI (the same NeoForge 1.21.1 port, published alongside this one)
- Required: [geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)
- Required: [curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios)

## How releases are made

Every release is built by the original author's own build from https://github.com/jivinstev/TheLastSword, passes automated checks (it builds, loads on a dedicated server, runs in a real client), and is played by a person before it is published here.
